name: Survival Adventure
description: The gather-craft-endure loop: land in a generated world, turn nodes into materials, materials into shelter and fire, and fire into surviving the night — then push deeper. combat.vital_stats supplies the drain, world.harvest_node and housing.build_placement supply the economy of answers, and world.fire_warmth plus inventory.spoilage_system make warmth and food logistics problems instead of inventory trivia.

signatureCompound.name: Survive the First Night
signatureCompound.description: Daylight hours to harvest wood and stone, a placed shelter and a lit fire before dusk, and vital stats that would kill an unprepared player overnight. The compound proves the loop's causal chain: gather feeds build, build feeds warmth, warmth beats the night's temperature drain.
